hero.title: TransformArte: Where Art and Mental Health Meet
hero.subtitle: Join our traveling tour and transform lives with your creativity.

home.summary: TransformArte is an initiative by Rotary District 4130 that combines the power of art with mental health prevention for young people aged 15 to 19. Through exhibitions, workshops, and auctions in seven cities across Mexico, we invite artists and Rotarians to donate works that inspire dialogue and awareness.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To promote mental health awareness among young people through art, creating a space for dialogue, expression, and community support.

testimonials.title: Messages
messages: Rotary International works for peace, health, and education. At TransformArte, we join their cause with art and community.
TransformArte is made possible thanks to Rotary's drive: leaders who transform the world from local to global.
Rotary connects the world. In this tour, we connect emotions, art, and mental health to heal together.
More than 1.2 million Rotarians worldwide share an ideal of service. Today, art joins as a vehicle for change.
TransformArte is art with purpose, backed by Rotary: a global network serving humanity.
Rotary has been serving the world for over 100 years. Today, their vision embraces youth mental health with creativity and empathy.
Each work in this tour carries the Rotary spirit: solidarity, leadership, and action for the common good.
Rotary doesn't just build wells and schools... it also builds hope. TransformArte is a reflection of this.
TransformArte celebrates art, mental health, and unity. Thanks to Rotary, this tour is a bridge of possibilities.
Rotary means action. Today, their action is to inspire through art to heal minds and hearts.

callToAction.title: Join the Movement
callToAction.description: Become part of TransformArte by donating your artwork or volunteering in our events.

project.title: Our Purpose: Art that Heals
project.subtitle: Discover how we combine creativity and mental health prevention in 7 cities.
project.objectives:
• Create spaces for artistic expression.
  • Promote educational workshops and webinars.
  • Raise funds through auctions and donations.
  • Build support networks between young people and Rotarians.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.workshops: Workshops: Sessions with psychologists and artists to explore emotions.
methodology.webinars: Webinars: Online talks about prevention and well-being.
methodology.auctions: Virtual Auctions: Auction platform for donated works.
